Markets.title: Concurrent Gainers: These 13 stocks gained for 5 days in a row, all rose over 27%

Markets.title: AI to lead investment strategy in 2027; Energy and borrowing costs shape macro outlook: Barclays
Markets.summary: Barclays Private Bank reports that artificial intelligence will lead investment strategy by 2027. However, rising debt financing costs and potential computing shortages could negatively impact infrastructure scalability.

Markets.title: Market winners: Max Healthcare, Deepak Fertilisers among 10 stocks that surged up to 14% in last week
Markets.summary: Max Healthcare, Deepak Fertilisers, and Blue Star led the Nifty 500 weekly gainers with surges of up to 14.14%. These ten stocks outperformed the broader index's 1.5% gain, driven by strong momentum across multiple sectors.

Markets.title: US Treasury yields drop for day and week; AI trade concern spurs safe-haven bid
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields dropped for both the day and the week as investor concerns over corporate debt and spending related to artificial intelligence triggered a safe-haven shift into government securities. Notably, the yield on the 10-year Treasury note fell below 5% for the first time in several months.

Geo-Political.title: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets UK's Streeting
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that recent strikes on the Crimean Bridge were a fair response to 109 Russian aerial attacks on Ukrainian bridges. He made the remarks during a meeting with UK Health Secretary Wes Streeting.

Geo-Political.title: Russia-bound ship attacked in Gulf of Finland
Geo-Political.summary: Finnish defense forces report that a Russia-bound ship was targeted in a drone attack in the Gulf of Finland. Officials state that Ukraine was likely responsible for the strike.

Geo-Political.title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock
Geo-Political.summary: Representatives from nearly 200 countries are deadlocked over fossil fuel policies during negotiations for a new global climate agreement at COP31. The nations are struggling to reach a consensus on how to address energy production and combat climate change.

Geo-Political.title: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out
Geo-Political.summary: Mexican authorities arrested high-ranking drug lord Fausto Isidro Meza Flores following a shootout. Meza Flores, who is on the FBI's ten most wanted list, faces accusations of drug trafficking and torture.

Geo-Political.title: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
Geo-Political.summary: The FBI is investigating an apparent hack of the National Crime Information Center database. Law enforcement agencies use this database to share sensitive criminal information.

Geo-Political.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper
Geo-Political.summary: Denmark expelled the Russian defense attaché after accusing Russia of plotting to assassinate a US-Ukrainian rapper on Danish soil. The Russian embassy in Denmark denied the allegation.

Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Modi criticized India Inc's continuous demand for tax concessions. Consequently, companies are preparing to defend their employment levels and salary growth against potential government resistance.

Data & Insights.summary: Trade unions have urged the Centre at a pre-Budget meeting to raise retirement gratuity, increase minimum wages, and expand social security schemes. They also requested enhanced protections for gig workers ahead of the 2027 Budget.

Data & Insights.summary: Taxpayers with undisclosed foreign assets up to ₹5 crore can declare multiple holdings under the FAST-DS scheme. The Central Board of Direct Taxes clarified this option in supplementary FAQs released on Friday.

Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has simplified export paperwork for individuals. It also established a specific payment cap for service exporters.

India.title: Yuzvendra Chahal Joins BJP, Gets Role In Party's OBC Morcha Committee
India.summary: Indian leg-spinner and former competitive chess player Yuzvendra Chahal has joined the Bharatiya Janata Party. He has also received a role in the party's OBC Morcha committee.

India.title: 'China Backed Pakistan During Operation Sindoor To Curb India's Rise': US Panel
India.summary: A US panel reported that China supported Pakistan during Operation Sindoor to curb India's rise. The report also identified India as one of the few non-allied powers with the scale to compete with China.

India.title: Analysis: BJP's Rural Reality Check - Congress Gains, Rashtriya Loktantrik Party Expands In Rajasthan
India.summary: Recent rural local body election results in Rajasthan indicate strong anti-incumbency sentiment against sitting cabinet members. During these elections, Congress made gains while the Rashtriya Loktantrik Party expanded its presence.

India.title: UP Cops Mistake Asaduddin Owaisi For Supreme Court Judge, Give Him Guard Of Honour
India.summary: Uttar Pradesh police mistakenly gave All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen chief Asaduddin Owaisi a guard of honour at a circuit house. The officers confused Owaisi with a Supreme Court judge who was expected to arrive at the location.

India.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Bridge Named After Nitish Kumar In Bihar's Vaishali
India.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated a bridge named after Nitish Kumar in Bihar's Vaishali district. Following the ceremony, Modi and several senior leaders took a short walk across the new bridge.

India.title: Kerala-Linked Drug Racket Busted In Mumbai, Nigerian Man Among 2 Arrested
India.summary: Police arrested a Nigerian national and his Mumbai resident wife in connection with a Kerala-linked drug racket. The arrests of 40-year-old Ikechukwu Paul Ogbonna and 42-year-old Aarthi took place in Ulwe within the Mumbai metropolitan region.
